item.text:
### (a) Three social posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will create more jobs than it eliminates. Our task is to prepare people for those opportunities—and make sure the gains reach everyone.

2. We see superintelligent AI as a job creator, not a jobs dead end. If it arrives within the next 20 years, it will create more jobs than it eliminates. We want education and training that help workers seize those opportunities.

3. We reject the idea that work has a fixed future. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will create more jobs than it eliminates. We stand for turning that growth into rewarding work and shared prosperity.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will create more jobs than it eliminates. We see a future of new industries, new services, and new kinds of work that expand what people can achieve. We do not confuse that growth with a painless transition: workers whose jobs disappear deserve practical support, strong protections, and clear routes into new opportunities. We want to start that work now, through education, training, and policies that spread the benefits of innovation. We stand for an ambitious future in which technological progress creates more opportunity—and we are committed to helping people thrive in it.
